findings.title: Containment condition exceeds rustfmt max_width, so `cargo fmt --check` fails
findings.body: The condition that checks the joined path stays inside the root is written on one line that is longer than rustfmt's `max_width` of 100 columns. CI runs `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, which rejects an unformatted line, so this pull request will fail the Rust formatting check until the line is wrapped.
findings.fix: Run `cargo fmt --all` and commit the wrapped condition.
